37675:   constructor
37676:   · intro hFree
37677:     change IsCancelSMul EffectiveGroup ℍ at hFree
37678:     rw [isCancelSMul_iff_stabilizer_eq_bot] at hFree
37679:     apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
37680:     intro z
37681:     exact hFree z
37682:   · intro hRegular
37683:     change IsCancelSMul EffectiveGroup ℍ
37684:     rw [isCancelSMul_iff_stabilizer_eq_bot]
37685:     intro z
37686:     have hz : z ∈ regularUpstairs := by
37687:       rw [hRegular]
37688:       exact Set.mem_univ z
37689:     exact hz
37690: 
37691: /-- Once the concrete arithmetic freeness theorem is proved, the effective
37692: orbit projection is a global covering map. -/
37693: theorem quotientProjection_isCoveringMap_of_effectiveActionFree
37694:     (hFree : EffectiveActionFree) :
37695:     IsCoveringMap Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk := by
37696:   letI : IsCancelSMul EffectiveGroup ℍ := hFree
37697:   simpa only [Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk, Quotient.mk''_eq_mk] using
37698:     (isQuotientCoveringMap_quotientMk_of_properlyDiscontinuousSMul
37699:       (G := EffectiveGroup) (E := ℍ)).isCoveringMap
37700: 
37701: /-- The same exact arithmetic input promotes the orbit projection to a
37702: global local homeomorphism, the topological precursor of quotient charts. -/
37703: theorem quotientProjection_isLocalHomeomorph_of_effectiveActionFree
37704:     (hFree : EffectiveActionFree) :
37705:     IsLocalHomeomorph Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk :=
37706:   (quotientProjection_isCoveringMap_of_effectiveActionFree hFree).isLocalHomeomorph
37707: 
37708: /-- Aggregate unconditional endpoint on the genuine regular quotient. -/
37709: theorem regularQuotientCoveringCertificate :
37710:     IsOpen regularUpstairs ∧
37711:       IsOpen regularQuotient ∧
37712:       Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' regularQuotient = regularUpstairs ∧
37713:       IsCoveringMapOn Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk regularQuotient ∧
37714:       IsLocalHomeomorphOn Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk
37715:         (Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' regularQuotient) := by
37716:   exact ⟨regularUpstairs_isOpen, regularQuotient_isOpen,
37717:     preimage_regularQuotient_eq_regularUpstairs,
37718:     quotientProjection_isCoveringMapOn_regular,
37719:     quotientProjection_isLocalHomeomorphOn_regular⟩
37720: 
37721: end QYM.FullCertification.P2RegularQuotientCoveringExtension

37727: #print axioms QYM.FullCertification.P2RegularQuotientCoveringExtension.quotientProjection_isCoveringMapOn_regular
37728: #print axioms QYM.FullCertification.P2RegularQuotientCoveringExtension.restrictedRegularProjection_isCoveringMap
37729: #print axioms QYM.FullCertification.P2RegularQuotientCoveringExtension.effectiveActionFree_iff_regularUpstairs_eq_univ

37737: 
37738: namespace QYM.FullCertification.P2GammaTwoFreeActionExtension
37739: 
37740: 
37741: 
37742: 
37743: /-!
37744: # Freeness of the effective `Gamma(2)` action
37745: 
37746: The principal congruence subgroup `Gamma(2)` contains the central matrices
37747: `±1`, so its raw action on the upper half-plane is not free.  The effective
37748: group used by the project is the image of that action in `Equiv.Perm ℍ`; the
37749: two central matrices have therefore already been identified.
37750: 
37751: This file proves the missing arithmetic fact rather than storing it as a
37752: certificate.  The proof moves a fixed point into Mathlib's closed modular
37753: fundamental domain, conjugates inside the normal subgroup `Gamma(2)`, uses
37754: Mathlib's complete finite list `cases_of_mem_fd_smul_mem_fd`, and eliminates
37755: every noncentral entry of that list by reduction modulo two.  It follows
37756: that the effective action is free and hence that the orbit projection is a
37757: genuine global covering map and local homeomorphism.
37758: -/
37759: 
37760: abbrev EffectiveGroup : Type := Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwoEffective
37761: 
37762: abbrev EffectiveQuotient : Type := Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwoQuotient
37763: 
37764: /-! ## 1. Stabilizers inside the closed modular fundamental domain -/
37765: 
37766: /-- A level-two matrix fixing a point of the closed modular fundamental
37767: domain is central.  All exceptional elliptic alternatives in the modular
37768: stabilizer classification have a matrix entry different from the identity
37769: modulo two. -/
37770: theorem gammaTwo_matrix_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mem_fd_fixed
37771:     {gamma : SL(2, ℤ)} {z : ℍ}
37772:     (hGamma : gamma ∈ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma 2)
37773:     (hz : z ∈ ModularGroup.fd)
37774:     (hfix : gamma • z = z) :
37775:     gamma = 1 ∨ gamma = -1 := by
37776:   rcases ModularGroup.cases_of_mem_fd_smul_mem_fd hz (hfix ▸ hz) with
37777:     hcentral | hT | hTinv | hS | hTS | hTinvSTinv |
37778:       hSTinv | hST | hTST | hTinvS
37779:   · exact hcentral
37780:   all_goals
37781:     rcases ‹(_ ∨ _) ∧ _› with ⟨hMatrix, _⟩
37782:     rcases hMatrix with rfl | rfl
37783:     all_goals
37784:       norm_num [CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_mem,
37785:         ModularGroup.S, ModularGroup.T] at hGamma
37786: 
37787: /-! ## 2. Arbitrary fixed points -/
37788: 
37789: /-- Every level-two matrix fixing an arbitrary upper-half-plane point is
37790: `1` or `-1`.  Normality of the principal congruence subgroup is essential:
37791: the matrix used to move the point into the modular fundamental domain need
37792: not itself belong to `Gamma(2)`. -/
37793: theorem gammaTwo_matrix_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_fixed
37794:     (gamma : Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) (hfix : gamma • z = z) :
37795:     (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) = 1 ∨ (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) = -1 := by
37796:   obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ModularGroup.exists_smul_mem_fd z
37797:   let delta : SL(2, ℤ) := a * (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) * a⁻¹
37798:   have hDeltaGamma :
37799:       delta ∈ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma 2 := by
37800:     exact (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_normal 2).conj_mem
37801:       (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) gamma.property a
37802:   have hfix' : (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) • z = z := by
37803:     change gamma • z = z
37804:     exact hfix
37805:   have hDeltaFix : delta • (a • z) = a • z := by
37806:     simp [delta, mul_smul, hfix', mul_assoc]
37807:   rcases gammaTwo_matrix_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mem_fd_fixed
37808:       hDeltaGamma ha hDeltaFix with hDelta | hDelta
37809:   · left
37810:     have h := congrArg (fun x : SL(2, ℤ) ↦ a⁻¹ * x * a) hDelta
37811:     simpa [delta, mul_assoc] using h
37812:   · right
37813:     have h := congrArg (fun x : SL(2, ℤ) ↦ a⁻¹ * x * a) hDelta
37814:     simpa [delta, mul_assoc] using h
37815: 
37816: /-! ## 3. Freeness after passing to the faithful permutation image -/
37817: 
37818: /-- An effective transformation fixing one upper-half-plane point is the
37819: identity permutation.  The two possible arithmetic representatives `±1`
37820: act identically, exactly as required by the effective-image construction.
37821: -/
37822: theorem gammaTwoEffective_eq_one_of_smul_eq
37823:     (g : EffectiveGroup) (z : ℍ) (hfix : g • z = z) :
37824:     g = 1 := by
37825:   rcases Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.effective_exists_gamma g with ⟨gamma, hRepresentative⟩
37826:   have hGammaFix : gamma • z = z := by
37827:     calc
37828:       gamma • z = g • z := (hRepresentative z).symm
37829:       _ = z := hfix
37830:   rcases gammaTwo_matrix_eq_one_or_neg_one_of_fixed
37831:       gamma z hGammaFix with hOne | hNegOne
37832:   · apply Subtype.ext
37833:     apply Equiv.ext
37834:     intro w
37835:     change g • w = w
37836:     have hgw : g • w = (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) • w :=
37837:       hRepresentative w
37838:     calc
37839:       g • w = (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) • w := hgw
37840:       _ = (1 : SL(2, ℤ)) • w := by rw [hOne]
37841:       _ = w := one_smul _ _
37842:   · apply Subtype.ext
37843:     apply Equiv.ext
37844:     intro w
37845:     change g • w = w
37846:     have hgw : g • w = (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) • w :=
37847:       hRepresentative w
37848:     calc
37849:       g • w = (gamma : SL(2, ℤ)) • w := hgw
37850:       _ = (-1 : SL(2, ℤ)) • w := by rw [hNegOne]
37851:       _ = (1 : SL(2, ℤ)) • w :=
37852:         ModularGroup.SL_neg_smul (g := (1 : SL(2, ℤ))) (z := w)
37853:       _ = w := one_smul _ _
37854: 
37855: /-- The faithful effective level-two action is genuinely free. -/
37856: noncomputable instance gammaTwoEffective_isCancelSMul :
37857:     IsCancelSMul EffectiveGroup ℍ :=
37858:   isCancelSMul_iff_eq_one_of_smul_eq.mpr
37859:     gammaTwoEffective_eq_one_of_smul_eq
37860: 
37861: /-- Every effective stabilizer is trivial, globally rather than only on a
37862: regular locus. -/
37863: theorem gammaTwoEffective_stabilizer_eq_bot (z : ℍ) :
37864:     MulAction.stabilizer EffectiveGroup z = ⊥ :=
37865:   IsCancelSMul.stabilizer_eq_bot z
37866: 
37867: /-! ## 4. Global covering consequences -/
37868: 
37869: /-- The actual effective orbit projection is a global covering map. -/
37870: theorem gammaTwoQuotientMk_isCoveringMap :
37871:     IsCoveringMap Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk := by
37872:   simpa only [Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk, Quotient.mk''_eq_mk] using
37873:     (isQuotientCoveringMap_quotientMk_of_properlyDiscontinuousSMul
37874:       (G := EffectiveGroup) (E := ℍ)).isCoveringMap
37875: 
37876: /-- Consequently the orbit projection is a global local homeomorphism. -/
37877: theorem gammaTwoQuotientMk_isLocalHomeomorph :
37878:     IsLocalHomeomorph Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk :=
37879:   gammaTwoQuotientMk_isCoveringMap.isLocalHomeomorph
37880: 
37881: /-- Every quotient point has an evenly covered neighbourhood. -/
37882: theorem gammaTwoQuotientMk_evenlyCovered
37883:     (x : EffectiveQuotient) :
37884:     IsEvenlyCovered Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk x
37885:       (Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' {x}) :=
37886:   gammaTwoQuotientMk_isCoveringMap x
37887: 
37888: /-! ## 5. An actual quotient atlas at the topological charted-space level -/
37889: 
37890: /-- A chosen upper-half-plane lift of a quotient point.  Every use is tied
37891: to the proved equation below, so no representative-dependent theorem is
37892: introduced. -/
37893: noncomputable def quotientLift (x : EffectiveQuotient) : ℍ :=
37894:   Classical.choose
37895:     (Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk_isOpenQuotientMap.surjective x)
37896: 
37897: @[simp]
37898: theorem quotientLift_spec (x : EffectiveQuotient) :
37899:     Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk (quotientLift x) = x :=
37900:   Classical.choose_spec
37901:     (Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk_isOpenQuotientMap.surjective x)
37902: 
37903: /-- The local homeomorphism supplied by the proved global covering at one
37904: chosen upstairs point. -/
37905: noncomputable def upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt (z : ℍ) :
37906:     OpenPartialHomeomorph ℍ EffectiveQuotient :=
37907:   Classical.choose (gammaTwoQuotientMk_isLocalHomeomorph z)
37908: 
37909: theorem upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt_mem_source (z : ℍ) :
37910:     z ∈ (upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt z).source :=
37911:   (Classical.choose_spec
37912:     (gammaTwoQuotientMk_isLocalHomeomorph z)).1
37913: 
37914: theorem upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt_eq_projection (z : ℍ) :
37915:     Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.gammaTwoQuotientMk = upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt z :=
37916:   (Classical.choose_spec
37917:     (gammaTwoQuotientMk_isLocalHomeomorph z)).2
37918: 
37919: /-- The inverse of a covering sheet at a chosen lift is a genuine quotient
37920: chart into the upper half-plane. -/
37921: noncomputable def quotientChartAtH (x : EffectiveQuotient) :
37922:     OpenPartialHomeomorph EffectiveQuotient ℍ :=
37923:   (upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt (quotientLift x)).symm
37924: 
37925: /-- The centre belongs to the source of its chosen quotient chart. -/
37926: theorem mem_quotientChartAtH_source (x : EffectiveQuotient) :
37927:     x ∈ (quotientChartAtH x).source := by
37928:   change x ∈
37929:     (upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt (quotientLift x)).target
37930:   have hMap :=
37931:     (upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt (quotientLift x)).map_source
37932:       (upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt_mem_source (quotientLift x))
37933:   rw [← upstairsLocalHomeomorphAt_eq_projection (quotientLift x)] at hMap
37934:   simpa using hMap
37935: 
37936: /-- The covering sheets form a concrete topological atlas modelled on `ℍ`.
37937: This is a `ChartedSpace` construction, not yet a claim that all chart
37938: transitions have been certified smooth. -/
37939: noncomputable def gammaTwoQuotientChartedSpaceH :
37940:     ChartedSpace ℍ EffectiveQuotient where
37941:   atlas := Set.range quotientChartAtH
37942:   chartAt := quotientChartAtH
37943:   mem_chart_source := mem_quotientChartAtH_source
37944:   chart_mem_atlas x := ⟨x, rfl⟩
37945: 
37946: /-- Register the actual covering-sheet atlas on the effective quotient. -/
37947: noncomputable instance gammaTwoQuotient_chartedSpaceH :
37948:     ChartedSpace ℍ EffectiveQuotient :=
37949:   gammaTwoQuotientChartedSpaceH
37950: 
37951: /-- Composing the covering-sheet charts with Mathlib's existing complex
37952: atlas on `ℍ` gives an explicit complex-modelled topological atlas. -/
37953: noncomputable instance gammaTwoQuotient_chartedSpaceComplex :
37954:     ChartedSpace ℂ EffectiveQuotient :=
37955:   ChartedSpace.comp ℂ ℍ EffectiveQuotient
